//: Example .claude/settings.local.json for nvim-mcp 'mirror' mode. The agent's built-in Bash tool still runs, but each command and its output are echoed into a Neovim log buffer (nvim-mcp://log) so you watch the agent's shell activity inside your editor. Requires the nvim-mcp-hook bin on PATH (npm i -g nvim-mcp) or change the command to an npx form. The :ClaudeCode plugin generates this for you.
